# POST /api/auth/signin/email/confirmation/otp

Confirm email signin with a verification code.

Requires an email-OTP access token in the access cookie or Authorization: Bearer, verified by middleware.
JSON contains only code and delivery; token fields in JSON are rejected.
Requires an existing active user and an active owner/admin organization membership.
Records a new session. Cookie delivery (default) requires an allowed Origin, sets both
HttpOnly cookies and returns lifetime metadata. Explicit delivery token returns
accessToken and refreshToken in JSON without setting cookies. Delivery is not a JWT claim.

## Authentication

Satisfy one of these alternatives (schemes within one alternative are all required):

- `{"emailOtp":[]}`

Encrypted email OTP challenge returned by the code request. Requires the email-OTP token variant; user access and refresh tokens are rejected. Supply it as Authorization: Bearer <challenge>.

```json
{
  "description": "Encrypted email OTP challenge returned by the code request. Requires the email-OTP token variant; user access and refresh tokens are rejected. Supply it as Authorization: Bearer <challenge>.",
  "scheme": "bearer",
  "type": "http"
}
```
- `{"emailOtpCookie":[]}`

HttpOnly OTP access cookie from the email code request. Nonsecure local development uses compallm-access. This token can confirm OTP but cannot authorize normal user APIs.

```json
{
  "description": "HttpOnly OTP access cookie from the email code request. Nonsecure local development uses compallm-access. This token can confirm OTP but cannot authorize normal user APIs.",
  "in": "cookie",
  "name": "__Host-access",
  "type": "apiKey"
}
```

## Request body

Required: **true**.

Content type: `application/json`.

Email challenge, verification code, and credential delivery for an existing user.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code | string | true | Six ASCII digits received by email; surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Valid for ten minutes. |
| delivery | string | false | How each signup/signin step delivers access credentials. Never stored in JWT claims. |

<details>
<summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "Email challenge, verification code, and credential delivery for an existing user.",
  "properties": {
    "code": {
      "description": "Six ASCII digits received by email; surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Valid for ten minutes.",
      "example": "123456",
      "maxLength": 6,
      "minLength": 6,
      "pattern": "^[0-9]{6}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "delivery": {
      "description": "How each signup/signin step delivers access credentials. Never stored in JWT claims.",
      "enum": [
        "cookie",
        "token"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "code"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>

Example (synthetic values):

```json
{
  "code": "123456",
  "delivery": "token"
}
```

### Example request

```bash
curl --request POST \
  'https://compallm.example/api/auth/signin/email/confirmation/otp' --header 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
  "code": "123456",
  "delivery": "token"
}'
```

Replace URL parameters and supply any required query values and authentication described above.

## Responses

### 200

Signed in; cookie mode returns lifetime metadata and sets both cookies; token mode returns both credentials

Content type: `application/json`.

Both delivery modes return validity metadata; only token delivery includes credentials.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| accessLifetime | object | true | Public timing metadata; contains no token claims or credentials. |
| accessToken | ["string","null"] | false | Access JWT, present only when delivery is token. |
| refreshLifetime | object | true | Public timing metadata; contains no token claims or credentials. |
| refreshToken | ["string","null"] | false | Refresh JWT, present only when delivery is token. |
